mappings.note: Live A toggles Arrangement Automation Mode (show/hide envelopes). Ardour toggles show/hide of existing automation lanes on selected tracks (or all tracks if none selected); it is not Live's overlay device/control chooser mode. Cross-ref S25-01 for hold-A momentary latching.
Installed Global a solos the selection; it does not toggle automation visibility.

Live Shift fine-scales vertical breakpoint/segment drag. Ardour ControlPointDrag/LineDrag already scale dy by 0.1 when fine_adjust_modifier matches exactly. macOS reset default is Control (Secondary). Remapping fine_adjust to Shift (Tertiary) would match Live but collide with snap bypass (Tertiary; S07-06) and RangeSelect. Shift_L documents the held Keyboard-hold modifier; Tertiary alone is not a valid XML accelerator. Cross-ref S06-04.

mappings.note: After keyboard reset defaults, fine_adjust_modifier is Secondary (Control); ControlPointDrag and LineDrag multiply dy by 0.1 when that modifier alone matches. This is Control-drag, not Live's Shift-drag. Push-points remains Cmd+Option (Primary|Level4).

Live Option-drags a line segment to create a curved segment (Option+double-click restores linear). Ardour automation allows only lane-level Discrete/Linear/Logarithmic/Exponential interpolation; ControlList::Curved is documented for x-fades only and is invalid for automation lines. Option/Level4 while dragging is snap-delta, not curve creation. Alt_L documents the held Keyboard-hold modifier.

mappings.note: Live Cmd+Delete deletes all automation for the selected control (clears the envelope). Ardour has AutomationTimeAxisView::clear_clicked (lane context-menu Clear) which clears the list and turns non-MIDI automation Off, but no bindable action. Primary-Delete is unbound (Primary-Tertiary-Delete is delete-section). Plain Delete is Editing/editor-delete (points/objects), not clear-envelope.

mappings.note: Evoral::ControlList::clear_list and AutomationControl::alist are Lua-bound. A script would still need a reliable way to resolve the Live-selected envelope (automation lane / touched control); Editor get_selection does not expose AutomationTimeAxisView clear directly. Undo/Off-state parity with clear_clicked remains open.

Same as S05-13/S13-07: ControlPointDrag uses snap_to_with_modifier; holding the snap modifier inverts grid snap. macOS reset default snap bypass is Shift (Tertiary); snap-delta is Option (Level4). Live's Cmd+drag conflicts with Command as SelectionToggle and drag constraint (Primary). Cross-ref S07-02: Shift is also Live's fine-drag modifier.

Matching Live's Cmd+drag snap bypass for breakpoints would require remapping snap_modifier to Primary and collides with SelectionToggle and constraint_modifier (both Primary on macOS). Also overlaps push_points when combined with Option.
